raw.setBoundary: Compute the day difference using (1) the date/proximity info for when you attended the Holiday Market relative to Black Friday, and (2) the date/proximity info for when you bought the iPhone 13 Pro (on Black Friday).
raw.missingRisk: If the iPhone purchase turn does not explicitly anchor the purchase to the exact Black Friday date (vs only “Black Friday” generically) or if the Holiday Market proximity is stated ambiguously (e.g., “around” a week), the downstream computation of exact day count could be off by a small amount.
